authoringNote: D1 reject contrast for case and metadata text. A whitespace-only subjectName fails CanonicalText, and the metadata provenance statement is ExactText, so the empty and whitespace-only statements fail DocumentExact. Schema reasons are reported together (D6): case_invalid at /case, then one document_metadata_invalid per invalid sidecar at /documents/<slot>/metadata. Both sidecars state a documentId and version that parse, so each reason carries that reference. Canonical order is by code, then reference (f25x2-encounter before f25x2-order). Each reason isolates its own input, so dropping any check changes the set. Source bodies are valid; no R09 result, no snapshot stage and no partial assessment.
